litigation.settlement_after_year_end_before_issuanc: Type I subsequent event if related to conditions at balance sheet date - recognize in financial statements

product_warranties.accounting: Expense warranty cost when sale made (matching principle)
product_warranties.estimate_based_on: Historical experience, % of sales, or units sold

journal_entries.at_sale: DR Warranty Expense, CR Warranty Liability

product_warranties.example: Sales $1M, est. warranty 2% = $20K. DR Warranty Expense $20K, CR Warranty Liability $20K

self_insurance.accounting: Do NOT accrue for self-insurance (no liability until claim occurs)
self_insurance.rationale: No existing obligation until loss event happens

guarantees.recognition: Recognize liability at inception for fair value of guarantee obligation
guarantees.disclosure: Always disclose guarantees, even if remote
guarantees.example: Guarantee subsidiary's debt: Recognize liability at FV of guarantee, disclose terms

environmental_liabilities.recognition: Accrue when probable and estimable (often from legal requirements or site assessment)
environmental_liabilities.measurement_issues: Long time horizon, uncertainty about remediation technology, discount to PV if timing/amount determinable

cpa_exam_tips: Warranties: Always accrue (matching). Self-insurance: Never accrue until claim.
Guarantees: Recognize liability at FV at inception + always disclose
Range of estimates with no best estimate: Accrue minimum

key_points: Self-insurance: No accrual until loss occurs
Guarantees: Recognize at FV, always disclose
Environmental: Accrue when probable and estimable
